promotion_note: PROMOTED 2026-08-01 (nyiso-109). NYISO keeper -> 2026-08-01-nyiso109-zonal-margin-anchor (bundle results/calibration/nyiso109_zonalanchor_B). DETERMINATION RECOVERS: NOT-YET (7 target-grade / 1 ledgered / 1 FAIL) -> CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS (8 target-grade / 1 ledgered / 0 FAILs). Every pre-registered gate in PREREG-nyiso109-zonal-margin-anchor-2026-08-01.md passes - construction K1-K6 and kills P1-P5 - and this promotion is the pre-registration's own verdict, not an override. ONE delta vs the nyiso-108 keeper: gas_offer_margin_zonal_anchor=true. IT ADDS ZERO FREE PARAMETERS (+1 DOF ledger entry, +0 residual-identified). WHAT IT FIXES, and it is an identification GRAIN error rather than a tuning lever: apply_gas_offer_margin adds markup_hr x (anchor - fuel) and states its own identity - at fuel == anchor the reformed offer reduces EXACTLY to the registered band multiplier - which is a statement about a unit's OWN delivered fuel. The ISO anchor (3.9046 $/MMBtu) is derived from data.fuel.trajectories._gas_series, which is ISO-LEVEL: it carries the hub overlay but NOT the per-zone basis the solve applies afterwards on the (n_gen, T) array. On the five ISOs whose fuel has no zonal spread that makes no difference; on NYISO it does, because apply_nyiso_zonal_gas_basis is anchored so the REFERENCE zone (Capital_Hudson, Iroquois Z2) is unchanged and every other zone shifts strictly DOWN to its own measured pipeline hub - NYC to Transco Z6 NY, Upstate_West to Tenn Z4 200L, a 1.34-3.08 $/MMBtu gap. Two of five zones, carrying 67.6 % of NYISO load, were therefore pricing their markup at a fuel level they never pay and collecting an uplift their band multiplier never contained. The zone anchors (Upstate_West 2.0346, NYC 2.7612, reference zones 3.9046 unchanged) are the SAME measurement as the ISO anchor evaluated per zone, produced by the same derive script (derive_gas_offer_margin_anchor.py --by-zone) applying the RUNTIME zonal-basis transform to the same delivered series over the same 2023-2025 training window - nothing chosen, nothing swept, rule-23 frozen. 234 of 404 marked-up tranches move onto a zone anchor; the median fixed margin falls 6.04 -> 5.39 $/MWh. GATES: K2 control integrity passes on the STRICT BYTE basis - the same-HEAD control reproduces the committed nyiso-108 keeper at EXACTLY 0.0 MW on every class-hour in all three years, so the A/B is unconfounded, and it does so despite four solve-path commits landing on main since that keeper's HEAD. K3 liveness: system lambda moves -0.871/-0.609/-0.602 $/MWh. K4: the recorded scenario blocks differ in exactly the two zonal-anchor keys. K5: both bundles [2023, 2024, 2025] - the holdout spend freeze is ACTIVE and untouched. K6 direction integrity: no zone's lambda RISES anywhere, as the construction requires (every zone anchor <= the ISO anchor, every markup >= 0). RESULT: C3a mean LMP 2023 +10.21 % -> +7.51 % clears the +/-10 % band and C3a becomes a PASS in all three years; C1 stays 14/14 all-class and 10/10 free-class; C2/C3b/C4/C6/C7/C8 all PASS; C3c is UNCHANGED (3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42) and stays the sole ledgered caveat. REPORTED COST, NOT HIDDEN: C3a 2025 moves -8.73 % -> -9.64 %, closer to the band edge. That is the honest signature of what this session diagnosed - the residual is not a level error but a COMPRESSED price distribution, sign-symmetric and present in ALL THREE YEARS (the model reproduces only 69/49/45 % of the measured trough->peak swing; the trough is over-priced by +7.3/+5.5/+8.7 $/MWh and the peak under-priced in 2024/2025). 2023 failed alone only because it is the mild year whose peak error is also positive, so nothing cancelled the trough excess. This lever corrects the trough half on measured grounds; THE PEAK HALF STAYS OPEN and is the named successor lane. The pre-registration declared the expected direction (weakly downward by construction) IN ADVANCE and fixed it as grounds for EXTRA scrutiny rather than encouragement (rule 1 [R-STRUCT], both directions): the lever is defended on the arithmetic of the mechanism's own stated identity, and would have been the correct change had C3a not moved at all. Evidence: results/calibration/FINDING-nyiso109-zonal-margin-anchor-2026-08-01.md; A/B JSON results/calibration/_nyiso109_zonal_anchor_ab.json; control 2026-07-31-nyiso109-control-zerodelta.

frontier.note: FRONTIER DECLARED + DETERMINATION MOVED NOT-YET -> CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS (owner decision, session nyiso-104: 'I am comfortable with taking c3c as a caveat and calling NYISO calibrated with caveats if we've exhausted options to address scarcity tail'). C3c was the SOLE blocker and every other criterion already PASSED; it is now carried as ONE ledgered caveat (budget 3) via the exceptions block of the keeper's calibration_attestation.json, generated by scripts/gen_nyiso100_attestation.py (the GENERATOR is the source of truth — editing only the emitted JSON is reverted by the next run). THE CAVEAT IS NOT A CLAIM THAT THE BENCHMARK IS WRONG: the measured RT tail is real (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300) and the model under-produces it. It records an EXHAUSTED lever queue on a diagnosed structural limitation of the five-zone representation — items 1/1b refused ex-ante on identification (nyiso-94/95), item 5 inert ex-ante (nyiso-93), items 2/3 closed and tested (nyiso-96), the last surviving candidate SCUC load-pocket security commitment + BPCG closed ex-ante on CONTENT not merely access (nyiso-97), import shape refused as an attributed C3c symptom with the seam exonerated (nyiso-99), G-J locality refused ex-ante for want of a representable boundary (nyiso-101). The one nominally-open item (nyiso_iroquois_winter_spread) is blocked on a joint SUMMER scarcity lever, and summer is exactly what is exhausted — nyiso-92 dated the actual RT tail as summer (2025 Jun 23-25 alone = 18 of 42 h; the Jan-2024 storm produced ZERO >$300 hours), capping the winter-fuel lane at ~4-5 h/yr. Rule 1 [R-STRUCT] is why this is a ledger entry and not a mechanism: every remaining way to lift the tail is fitted to the tail residual. RE-OPEN CONDITION, satisfiable: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT makes the sub-zonal load pocket representable — its own owner charter (the ERCOT West/Panhandle class, CLOSED), never a mechanism-flag lever. KEEPER UNCHANGED (2026-07-30-nyiso-100-silretire) and NO SOLVE RAN — this is a scorer-side reclassification on the committed bundle. Holdout: NYISO re-declared in the `complete` (VALIDATION-tier) block of calibration-complete.json — 2022 + the 2018/2020/2021 ladder, NOT training; it is deliberately ABSENT from the new `final` (locked-test) block, so 2019 / H1-2026 stay blocked. The ACTIVE holdout spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve regardless, so nothing is spendable until the owner lifts it. Evidence: docs/FINDING-nyiso104-c3c-frontier-and-tiered-holdout-2026-07-31.md.
frontier.amendment_note: THE C3c FRONTIER DECLARATION STANDS, AND ITS PREMISE IS RESTORED. nyiso-108's amendment recorded that the nyiso-104b premise - C3c is the SOLE blocker and every other criterion PASSES - had lapsed, because the hydro input repair exposed a real 2023 fossil over-pricing that failed C3a. nyiso-109 closed that defect on measured grounds (the gas-offer margin anchor resolved per zone, zero free parameters), so C3a PASSES in all three years and C3c is once again the SOLE remaining miss, carried as ONE ledgered caveat. NYISO's determination is CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS. C3c itself is UNCHANGED across this A/B (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300 in both arms), so no C3c evidence moved, the exhausted-queue finding is untouched, no new caveat slot is spent, and the re-open condition is unchanged: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT under its own owner charter, never a mechanism-flag lever. WHAT IS EXPLICITLY *NOT* RESTORED IS THE 'options exhausted' READING. nyiso-109 measured a second, non-C3c, structurally real and still-open defect: the model's price DISTRIBUTION is compressed in all three years - it reproduces only 69/49/45 % of the measured trough->peak swing, and after this arm the peak half remains under-priced (C3a 2025 -9.64 %, inside the band but nearer its edge). That defect passes every current gate, so it is not a blocker; it is an open structural item with no lever chartered yet, and it is the named successor lane. Holdout unaffected: NYISO keeps `complete`, stays ABSENT from `final`, and the ACTIVE spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve.
